test_title: PYST 2: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to improve the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to improve it, select ‘No improvement required’.

I had to wait for fifteen minutes __to__ the bus.
solution:
The correct answer is **'for'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**When we read the given sentence, we get to know that the wrong preposition is used.

__
 
• We generally use the preposition **'for'** ***to state the purpose of an object or action.***
 
• For example:
 
 
• She used the basement **for** storage.
 
• She had to wait **for **thirty minutes for her friend.
 
 

After observing the above examples, the given sentence should be - ***I had to wait for fifteen minutes for __the bus.***

Hence, the correct answer is **option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**The preposition **'to' **is used when we move from one place to another.

 
• He is going **to **Delhi tomorrow.
 
• I have already gone **to **Mumbai many times.
